name: Zoom-out Adaptation
definition: A technique to adapt a pre-trained 3DGS model for anti-aliased rendering at lower resolutions (zoom-out) by generating pseudo-ground truth (pseudo-GT) through downsampling high-resolution renderings.
summary: Zoom-out Adaptation is a post-training optimization that adapts 3D Gaussian Splatting models to render anti-aliased images at lower resolutions by re-optimizing Gaussians against pseudo-ground truth generated from downsampled high-resolution renderings.
